# harmonysase_regions (Data Source)

Catalogue of Harmony SASE regions available for Standard or Enhanced networks. Use this to look up `harmony_sase_region_id` values without hardcoding catalogue IDs in HCL.

Note: the API's `name` and `display_name` fields can diverge for some regions (e.g. `displayName="Tokyo 1"` vs `name="Tokyo"`). Both are exposed here; pick whichever matches what you'll see at the source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a single region by display_name.
data "harmonysase_regions" "london3" {
  display_name = "London 3"
}

# All regions in a country.
data "harmonysase_regions" "uk_all" {
  country_code = "GB"
}

# Wire into a network resource:
resource "harmonysase_standard_network" "main" {
  name   = "production-network"
  subnet = "10.255.0.0/16"

  initial_region = {
    harmony_sase_region_id = data.harmonysase_regions.london3.regions[0].id
    scale_units            = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `continent_code` (String) Filter to all regions with the given continent code (e.g. `EU`, `NA`, `AS`).
- `country_code` (String) Filter to all regions with the given ISO country code (case-insensitive, e.g. `GB`).
- `display_name` (String) Filter to a single region whose `display_name` matches (case-insensitive, exact).
- `name` (String) Filter to a single region whose API `name` matches (case-insensitive, exact).
- `network_type` (String) Which catalogue to fetch. One of `standard` (default) or `enhanced`.

### Read-Only

- `by_display_name` (Attributes Map) Convenience map of matching regions keyed by `display_name`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_display_name))
- `by_name` (Attributes Map) Convenience map of matching regions keyed by API `name`. May contain fewer entries than `regions` if duplicate names exist (none observed in practice). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--by_name))
- `regions` (Attributes List) All regions matching the filters, in the order returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--by_display_name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `by_display_name`

Read-Only:

- `continent_code` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `display_name` (String) User-facing label as shown in the SASE admin UI.
- `id` (String) Catalogue region ID. This is the value to put into `harmony_sase_region_id`.
- `name` (String) API `name` field. Often but not always equal to `display_name`.
